about: A JavaScript library for working with colors.

prs.title: oklab and oklch colors keep 3 decimals
prs.broken: Colors written as oklab or oklch text were rounded to 2 decimals, which on that small scale visibly changed the color.
prs.matters: A color saved as text and read back looks the same as before.

prs.title: Averaging oklch colors goes around the color wheel
prs.broken: Averaging red and pink in oklch gave teal, because the hue was averaged as a plain number, not an angle.
prs.changed: The hue is now averaged around the circle, as it is for the other color modes.
prs.matters: Blends in oklch give the color people expect, matching other color libraries.
